{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [15:0] bit_eq;
    wire [15:0] bit_gt;
    wire [15:0] bit_lt;

    assign bit_eq = ~(A ^ B);
    assign bit_gt = A & ~B;
    assign bit_lt = ~A & B;

    wire [7:0] eq2;
    wire [7:0] gt2;
    wire [7:0] lt2;
    wire [3:0] eq4;
    wire [3:0] gt4;
    wire [3:0] lt4;
    wire [1:0] eq8;
    wire [1:0] gt8;
    wire [1:0] lt8;
    wire eq16;
    wire gt16;
    wire lt16;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : pair_level
            assign eq2[i] = bit_eq[2*i] & bit_eq[2*i+1];
            assign gt2[i] = bit_gt[2*i+1] | (bit_eq[2*i+1] & bit_gt[2*i]);
            assign lt2[i] = bit_lt[2*i+1] | (bit_eq[2*i+1] & bit_lt[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1) begin : quad_level
            assign eq4[i] = eq2[2*i] & eq2[2*i+1];
            assign gt4[i] = gt2[2*i+1] | (eq2[2*i+1] & gt2[2*i]);
            assign lt4[i] = lt2[2*i+1] | (eq2[2*i+1] & lt2[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 2; i = i + 1) begin : octet_level
            assign eq8[i] = eq4[2*i] & eq4[2*i+1];
            assign gt8[i] = gt4[2*i+1] | (eq4[2*i+1] & gt4[2*i]);
            assign lt8[i] = lt4[2*i+1] | (eq4[2*i+1] & lt4[2*i]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq16 = eq8[0] & eq8[1];
    assign gt16 = gt8[1] | (eq8[1] & gt8[0]);
    assign lt16 = lt8[1] | (eq8[1] & lt8[0]);

    assign eq = eq16;
    assign gt = gt16;
    assign lt = lt16;
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The original comparator's mapped critical paths are dominated by priority-comparison logic spanning many operand bits, with the worst reported path reaching gt through several reconvergent AOI/OAI stages.",
  "rewrite": "The rewrite constructs equality, greater-than, and less-than status for adjacent bit pairs and combines those results through balanced 2-bit, 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit prefix levels. The most-significant group controls each combine stage, preserving unsigned comparison priority while reducing serial priority depth.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Balanced prefix composition should reduce maximum data arrival relative to a flattened serial comparator, particularly for low-order input bits that otherwise traverse the longest priority chain. The exact gain depends on Yosys and SKY130HD mapping choices.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The design adds explicit intermediate prefix signals and computes both comparison directions through shared equality terms. This may modestly increase cell count or wiring relative to aggressive mapper sharing, but the regular two-input combine structure is expected to remain within the stated area cap and has no storage or latency cost.",
  "functional_boundaries": "A and B remain unsigned 16-bit operands with the original port names, widths, and default unsigned signedness. For every binary input combination, eq is asserted exactly when A equals B, gt exactly when A is greater than B, and lt exactly when A is less than B. The outputs remain mutually exclusive and no assumptions about input behavior are used."
}
